text.aria-label: Title text 'The lag gap at the eight MVA Primaries sits at D4, D12, and D19; D8 goes the other way CRPS gap at 24-120 h; above zero means the lag arm is better. Dot: estimate (2 seeds). Line: uncorrected 95% interval from resampling whole months (5 blocks).'
text.tspan: The lag gap at the eight MVA Primaries sits at D4, D12, and D19; D8 goes the other way
CRPS gap at 24-120 h; above zero means the lag arm is better. Dot: estimate (2 seeds).
Line: uncorrected 95% interval from resampling whole months (5 blocks).
